Russian Language
The **Russian Language** is a mandatory requirement for various academic programs across different faculties in Russian universities. It serves as a standard component of entrance exams, often alongside other subjects such as mathematics, informatics/computer technology (ICT), or physics, depending on the specific field of study. 

Universities requiring this subject include those offering geological and geophysical studies, mechanical-mathematical faculties, economic faculties, and programs in philosophy and jurisprudence. Additionally, it is typically included as part of the general requirements for university admissions, reflecting its importance in higher education systems throughout Russia.

While the exact nature of the exam may vary slightly between institutions—some focusing more heavily on grammar and vocabulary, others emphasizing comprehension and writing skills—the overarching goal remains consistent: ensuring students possess sufficient proficiency in the Russian language to succeed academically within Russian educational environments.<SEP>A mandatory entrance exam subject.

Novosibirsk State University
Novosibirsk State University (NSU), also known as НГУ, is a large Russian research university located in Akademgorodok, Novosibirsk. It holds the statuses of a national research university and a federal autonomous university, with a core focus on the integration of education and science and the early involvement of students in research activities.

The university comprises multiple faculties, including the Faculty of Natural Sciences, the Physical Faculty, and the Geological and Geophysical Faculty. It publishes its own admission requirements and organizes a wide array of academic and extracurricular events, such as the "Scientific Picnic." NSU supports student initiatives and hosts various clubs and circles, including those for foreign students.

In terms of student support and infrastructure, Novosibirsk State University offers the NSU+ scholarship and provides various infrastructure services.
